skills.name: workiom-vibe-apps
skills.description: Generate Workiom "vibe apps" — self-contained static web apps, one page or several plus any assets they need, that run inside a Workiom tenant at {tenant}.workiom.com/vibe/{appId}/ and interact with Workiom lists using the logged-in viewer's own session. Use this skill whenever the user asks to build, generate, change, or package an internal Workiom page, form, tracker, or mini-app — e.g. "I need an app that collects bug reports", "make a form that writes to our Leads list", "add a field to the vibe app we made". Covers the full pipeline: light intake → schema discovery via the Workiom MCP → schema-grounded requirements confirmation → generation → validation via scripts/vibe-pack.py → optional in-chat preview → publishing through the Workiom MCP. Also edits apps that already exist, by fetching their real source rather than regenerating them. The deliverable is a live app the user can open, not a file to hand off.
headings: Step 0 — Gate: verify Workiom access FIRST
Platform constraints (violations = broken page, not rejected upload)
Visual design — the bar is "beautiful," not merely "clean"
Theme the design to the app's subject
Choose the display pattern the data actually fits — not always a table
Editing an app you didn't build in this session
skills.description_zh: 生成或修改在Workiom租户内运行的独立静态内部页面、表单、跟踪器及小应用，使用查看者自己的登录会话操作列表；通过MCP发现真实结构、确认需求、生成并验证后发布，修改既有应用时读取实际源码，交付可打开的在线应用。
